اصطلقا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَقَا (iṣṭalaqā) /isˤ.tˤa.la.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اُصْطُلِقَا (uṣṭuliqā) /usˤ.tˤu.li.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلِقَا (iṣṭaliqā) /isˤ.tˤa.li.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
